subject: CMA Awards voting
title: How are the CMA Awards voted on? Who picks the 2026 winners
answer: CMA Awards nominees and winners are chosen by the Country Music Association's more than 7,000 professional members, including artists, songwriters, musicians, executives, publicists and touring staff. They vote in three rounds by emailed ballot. For 2026, the final ballot closed Oct. 27, and winners are revealed live on ABC on Nov. 18.
body:
According to the CMA, only its Professional voting members can vote. The 2026 nomination ballot ran July 6-16, the second ballot Aug. 4-17 and the final ballot Oct. 1-27, with each round closing at 6 p.m. Central on its last day. Music released between July 1, 2025, and June 30, 2026, was eligible, and the CMA Board of Directors sets the rules. Fans do not vote in the CMA Awards.

The 60th annual CMA Awards air live from Nashville on Wednesday, Nov. 18, 2026, at 8 p.m. ET (7 p.m. Central) on ABC, the show's home since 2006. Lainey Wilson returns as host. Ella Langley leads the nominations with nine.

The Entertainer of the Year nominees are Luke Combs, Cody Johnson, Ella Langley, Chris Stapleton and Lainey Wilson. The New Artist of the Year nominees are Avery Anna, Carter Faith, Emily Ann Roberts, Tucker Wetmore and Stephen Wilson Jr.
in_the_news: The 60th CMA Awards air on ABC on Nov. 18, 2026, three weeks after CMA members cast their final ballots.
